meaning:
αὐθάδης, -ες
(αὐτος, ἥδομαι), [in LXX: Gen.49:3, 7 (עַז), Pro.21:24 (יָהִיר)* ;]
self-pleasing, arrogant: Tit.1:7, 2Pe.2:10 (Cremer, 654).†
SYN.: φίλαυτος (see Tr., Syn., § xciii) (AS)

elsewhere.note: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
